```{r setup}
#| include: false
# Render from the checkout, after `mix fitness.export`:
#   quarto render analysis/fitness_report.qmd --output-dir ../tmp/fitness-report \
#     -P db:$HOME/streetscissors-data/streetscissors.db
# Paths in params are relative to the checkout.
root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), ".."))
at <- function(p) if (nzchar(p) && !startsWith(p, "/")) file.path(root, p) else p
source(file.path(root, "analysis", "fitness_models.R"))
library(ggplot2)
m <- run_models(
  at(params$csv),
  if (nzchar(params$db)) params$db else NULL,
  at(params$block),
  if (nzchar(params$flare_date)) params$flare_date else NULL
)
fitted <- Filter(function(b) isTRUE(b$ok), m$banister)
```

**`r m$block$title %||% "No block"`**, from `r m$block$start %||% "—"`:
`r nrow(m$logs)` entries over `r m$n_weeks` week(s) with data,
`r nrow(m$checkins)` check-ins, `r nrow(m$rides)` activities.

## Fitness and fatigue (Banister)

Each lift's estimated one-rep max is modelled as a baseline plus fitness
minus fatigue, each a decaying sum of the daily volume load. With fewer than
15 sessions the time constants are held at 42 and 7 days and only the
gains are fitted. A point above its line is a day better than the load
predicted; below, worse.

```{r banister}
#| fig-height: 4
if (length(fitted)) {
  d <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitted, function(b) cbind(lift = b$slug, b$data)))
  ggplot(d, aes(date)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = fitted), colour = site_colours[["ink3"]]) +
    geom_point(aes(y = e1rm, shape = anomaly), size = 2) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 4), name = "Anomaly") +
    facet_wrap(~lift, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "e1RM (lb)") +
    theme_site()
} else {
  cat("No lift has the six sessions a fit needs yet.\n")
}
```

```{r banister-table}
if (length(fitted)) {
  knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(fitted, function(b) data.frame(
    lift = b$slug,
    sessions = nrow(b$data),
    `time constants` = if (b$taus_fitted) "fitted" else "held at 42 / 7",
    `fitness gain` = signif(b$par["k1"], 3),
    `fatigue gain` = signif(b$par["k2"], 3),
    `residual sd (lb)` = round(stats::sd(b$data$residual), 1),
    check.names = FALSE
  ))), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Load by pattern (ACWR)

Seven days' load over the 28-day weekly average. The band is 0.8–1.3; over
1.5 is where the guardrails hold the weight. Endurance is the rides'
minutes.

```{r acwr}
#| fig-height: 3.5
a <- m$acwr[!is.na(m$acwr$acwr), ]
if (nrow(a)) {
  ggplot(a, aes(date, acwr, colour = pattern)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0.8, ymax = 1.3, alpha = 0.12) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_line() +
    scale_colour_site() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "ACWR", colour = NULL) +
    theme_site()
} else {
  cat("No pattern has 28 days of load yet.\n")
}
```

## Anomalies

```{r anomalies}
an <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitted, function(b) {
  x <- b$data[b$data$anomaly, ]
  if (nrow(x)) cbind(lift = b$slug, x[, c("date", "e1rm", "fitted", "residual")])
}))
if (is.null(an) || !nrow(an)) cat("None.\n") else knitr::kable(an, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Question of the week

**Does a ride in the 24 hours before a lift cost the lift?** The test
compares the Banister residuals of sessions with a ride of 30 minutes or
more in the day before them against those without. It uses a permutation
test, since the groups are small and need not be normal.

```{r question}
q <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fitted, function(b) b$data))
if (!is.null(q) && nrow(q) && nrow(m$rides)) {
  rode <- vapply(q$date, function(d) {
    any(m$rides$date %in% c(d - 1, d) & m$rides$minutes >= 30)
  }, logical(1))
  if (sum(rode) >= 3 && sum(!rode) >= 3) {
    observed <- mean(q$residual[rode]) - mean(q$residual[!rode])
    set.seed(1)
    perm <- replicate(5000, {
      s <- sample(rode)
      mean(q$residual[s]) - mean(q$residual[!s])
    })
    p <- mean(abs(perm) >= abs(observed))
    cat(sprintf(
      "After a ride: %d sessions; without: %d. Difference in residual: %+.1f lb (permutation p = %.2f).\n",
      sum(rode), sum(!rode), observed, p
    ))
  } else {
    cat("Too few sessions on each side yet (needs three with a ride the day before and three without).\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Needs fitted lifts and rides.\n")
}
```
